name: HAICOSYSTEM
description: HAICOSYSTEM is a modular sandbox environment designed to simulate multi-turn interactions between human users and AI agents equipped with various tools, across diverse scenarios and domains. It provides a comprehensive multi-dimensional evaluation framework to assess operational, content-related, societal, and legal safety risks in AI-human interactions.
reputation: A recent safety-oriented sandbox benchmark that is gaining attention for multi-turn agent safety evaluation, but it is not yet a widely established community standard.
notes: Includes 1840 simulations based on 92 scenarios across seven domains; focuses on safety risks in AI-human interactions.
